knewsr

한국어

knewsr collects and preprocesses Korean news data and runs basic text analysis in a few lines of R: term frequencies, TF-IDF, document-term matrices, co-occurrence, keyness and term trends over time. Excel, CSV and JSON files (including BigKinds exports), any data frame with title or body columns, the Naver News Search API and RSS/Atom feeds all feed into the same pipeline.

Installation

knewsr is not on CRAN yet. Install the development version from GitHub:

devtools::install_github("sorrychoe/knewsr")

By default, tokenize_ko() splits the keyword column (such as the keyword lists in BigKinds exports) and needs no morphological analyser. Data without a keyword column, such as Naver or RSS collections, must be tokenized from the title or body (field = "title" or "text"), which needs the MeCab-ko system library, mecab-ko-dic and the RcppMeCab package. Reading JSON files needs jsonlite, collecting from Naver needs httr2 and collecting RSS needs xml2. Set the Naver API keys in the NAVER_CLIENT_ID and NAVER_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.

Usage 

library(knewsr)

news <- as_news(president_lee_2026_08) |> clean_news()
#> Detected columns: doc_id <- `뉴스 식별자`, date <- `일자`, source <- `언론사`,
#> title <- `제목`, keyword <- `키워드`
# or read_news("folder/"), collect_naver("query"), collect_rss("https://.../rss")
tokens <- tokenize_ko(news, keep = "source")

count_terms(tokens)
#> # A tibble: 10,098 × 2
#>    token      n
#>    <chr>  <int>
#>  1 대통령  1400
#>  2 정부     585
#>  3 후보     507
#>  4 이재명   463
#>  5 대표     454
#>  6 의원     423
#>  7 국민     407
#>  8 민주당   283
#>  9 정책     278
#> 10 청와대   272
#> # ℹ 10,088 more rows
keyness(tokens, group = "source", target = "조선일보")
#> # A tibble: 10,098 × 5
#>    token n_target n_reference keyness        p
#>    <chr>    <int>       <int>   <dbl>    <dbl>
#>  1 장씨        30           0   160.  1.41e-36
#>  2 실종        26          17    83.0 8.16e-20
#>  3 발견        20           9    71.7 2.49e-17
#>  4 경장        17           4    70.5 4.60e-17
#>  5 한미        24          35    53.0 3.41e-13
#>  6 시신        11           1    51.7 6.39e-13
#>  7 후보        82         425    49.3 2.21e-12
#>  8 훈련        23          37    47.8 4.78e-12
#>  9 골프        15          17    38.0 7.21e-10
#> 10 펜션         7           0    37.2 1.07e- 9
#> # ℹ 10,088 more rows
Step Functions
Input read_news(), read_bigkinds(), as_news()
Collection collect_naver(), collect_rss()
Preprocessing clean_news(), tokenize_ko(), ngrams_ko(), stopwords_ko()
Analysis count_terms(), tf_idf(), as_dtm(), as_tdm(), cooccurrence(), keyness(), term_trend(), summarise_corpus()
Visualization plot_terms(), plot_keyness(), plot_trend(), plot_wordcloud(), plot_network()

See vignette("getting-started", package = "knewsr") for the full workflow.
